implementedOrPassed: A6 character records are used for the runner party and MIKU; J&C mask ids Mischief and Service are passed and engine-valid.
Marian Trust + Prosperity migration, Prosperity opening Highlight 25, and the live-profile Trust + Prosperity party-damage effect are represented.
Berry's 15 equipped screenshot values are stored and passed as equipped totals, avoiding double-addition of overlapping Revelation stat percentages.
MIKU navigator actions and observed song effects are available when MIKU is selected; the runner explicitly derives its navigator definition from the catalog.
Dionysus Revolution, Universal Theoria, and Tarukaja are runner-defined; Vasuki Venomous Spiral, Media, and Rakunda are runner-defined.
partialOrAdapterOnly: Rakunda's 42.7% Defense reduction for 3 turns and 22 SP are supplied by a runner adapter because the catalog marks it reference-only.
Dionysus Auto-Mataru IV's 9.8% party Attack for 2 turns is supplied by a runner adapter and removed when Wonder leaves Dionysus.
The runner's MIKU free song selection is a local adapter rather than a shared engine command.
The app has generic three-Persona editing, but the runner only passes Dionysus and Vasuki for this checkpoint.
notPassedOrUnsupported: J&C Creation + Reconcilation Revelation loadout is absent from the checkpoint runner loadouts.
MIKU Integrity + Labor Revelation loadout is absent from the checkpoint runner loadouts.
Wonder Janosik and the observed Vasuki to Janosik to Dionysus transition are absent from the runner path.
Exact weapon names, ranks, stats, passive effects, and borrowed equipment effects are not passed by the inspected app or runner.

Exact Revelation card effects for Creation + Reconcilation and Integrity + Labor are not established as battle formulas by this evidence set. Local Labor has an HP combat field, while its Navigator-thief four-piece text is not passed as the full user loadout effect.
Observed live score conversion, survival bonus, final score, and full late-turn rotation are not implemented as this runner's parity claim.

unknownsAndGuardrails: Do not infer exact weapon or Revelation effects from the buffed BERRY snapshot. Its source explicitly says borrowed and stacked effects are not fully identified.
Do not treat A6R6 as proof of exact weapon/card rank mechanics without a direct source field or screenshot for that rank.
Do not treat the runner's default seed 8 as a score-calibrated choice. It was selected for a J&C Gun critical after the opening random draw.
Do not claim full live parity from the 6,101,612,096 result. The checkpoint note identifies unresolved score, damage, role, Persona, and charge differences.
No simulation, replay test, or optimizer result was generated for this inventory.
